h1: Custom Xsmall Caps for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom xsmall caps in bulk for kids or snug fits. Perfect Imprints offers quality decoration options. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Xsmall caps are designed for children or adults who prefer a snug, low-profile fit. Unlike standard sizes, these caps sit closer to the head without excess fabric, making them ideal for youth teams, school events, or promotional giveaways where a tailored look matters. Choose embroidery or screen printing to add your logo on cotton twill or polyester mesh styles.
heroAltText: Bulk custom xsmall caps with embroidered logo on front, available in various colors
